import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { constraintShapes } from "./constraint_shapes";

// Introspected as an owned-child: belongs to constraint_shapes (its only ON DELETE CASCADE foreign key) and nothing else references it.
export const constraintShapesChild = defineTable("constraint_shapes_child", {
    columns: {
        id: col.integer().primaryKey(),
        parentId: col.integer().notNull(),
        note: col.text()
    },
    relations: {
        parent: rel.belongsTo(() => constraintShapes, { onDelete: "cascade" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
